subject: x must contain finite values only

messages.author: 6f81c58ba9ed02c3
messages.subject: x must contain finite values only
parts:
Hello lavaan community,

In lavaan version 0.6-5, I ran a series of parallel process growth models in which sampling weights were employed using the "sample.weights" sub-command in the growth command. The estimator was set to MLR and missing was set to fiml. Recently, I re-ran the analyses using lavaan version 0.6.6, and I received the following error message:

Error in stats::cov.wt(Y, wt = wt, method = "ML") :
  'x' must contain finite values only

I updated lavaan to the most current development version, restarted my session, and tried again. However, I still received the same error message. When I reverted to lavaan version 0.6-5, the analyses ran with no issues.

I was wondering if anyone could help me figure out why I am getting this error message in version 0.6-6.

Thank you,

Ryan
